card.name: Words right before 'reasonable' or 'ordinary skill'
card.fires_on: Small linking words just before a standard-of-care or skill phrase, such as 'Those of ordinary skill', 'must take reasonable steps', or 'make every effort'. The next word is expected to be 'reasonable' or a similar word.

modes.label: Patent skill phrase

modes.description: Words before 'reasonable' in negligence and duty-of-care text.
modes.example: Schools must<< take>> reasonable steps to keep students from harming one

modes.label: Effort or limit wording
modes.description: Words before 'reasonable', 'possible' or 'effort' in advice to keep something minimal or to try hard.
modes.example: physicians should make<< every>> effort to discontinue the use of en
